title: MRR Hypothesis
description: docs/spec/02_DOMAIN_MODEL.md section 2.4 ('Hypothesis and ResearchBranch'): 'Hypothesis captures a falsifiable proposition or an explicit insufficient_evidence branch.' Third task of Epic E4 (task-packets/E4-T03.yaml); the fourteenth entity schema in this repository. docs/spec/02_DOMAIN_MODEL.md lists 'dependencies and assumptions' as one bullet; this schema splits it into two fields ('dependencies', a list of URNs to other objects this branch depends on, matching MRR-FR-012's own 'dependencies' wording, and 'assumptions', a list of free-text epistemic assumptions) because MRR-FR-012 names 'dependencies' specifically as one of the five required declarations, distinct from the branch's assumptions. NOT A CLAIM OF RESULT (MRR-FR-014, AGENTS.md rule 7): this schema declares no verified/supported/result/authoritative property of any kind, and 'status' is a small, closed lifecycle enum (proposed/selected/deferred/rejected) with NO 'verified' value anywhere — a Hypothesis is a PROPOSAL (docs/spec/01_SYSTEM_SPEC.md section 5, autonomy level A1: 'propose hypotheses ... clearly marked proposal'), never an authoritative judgment about whether it holds. FALSIFIABILITY, ENFORCED TWICE (mirrors schemas/claim.schema.json's own if/then precedent, and the same 'enforced identically in JSON Schema and Pydantic' approach schemas/evidence-anchor.schema.json and schemas/verification-result.schema.json already use): for every branch_role EXCEPT 'insufficient_evidence', predicted_observations and disconfirming_observations must each have at least one entry (a falsifiable proposition needs both a predicted and a disconfirming observation); the 'insufficient_evidence' role may leave both empty but MUST record a non-null insufficiency_rationale instead (the two if/then conditionals below are mutually exclusive and jointly exhaustive over the six-value branch_role enum). insufficiency_rationale itself is not a docs/spec/02_DOMAIN_MODEL.md 2.4 bullet — it is this task's own minimal, necessary addition (the task packet's own invariant wording: 'must record an insufficiency rationale'), the same kind of documented addition schemas/evidence-anchor.schema.json's own anchor_unavailable_reason already is for its entity.

statement.description: The falsifiable proposition itself (domain 2.4 'hypothesis statement'), or a plain statement of the question left unresolved when branch_role == 'insufficient_evidence'.

branch_role.description: MRR-FR-010's exact six branch roles — a closed enum, no seventh value accepted.

predicted_observations.description: What would be observed if this hypothesis holds. Non-empty for every branch_role except insufficient_evidence (see the if/then conditionals below).

disconfirming_observations.description: What would be observed if this hypothesis does NOT hold (the falsifying observations). Non-empty for every branch_role except insufficient_evidence.

insufficiency_rationale.description: Non-null exactly when branch_role == 'insufficient_evidence': the recorded reason evidence is insufficient to state a falsifiable proposition. Null (and typically absent) for every other branch_role.

dependencies.description: MRR-FR-012's own 'dependencies': URNs of other objects (prior hypotheses, claims, or evidence) this branch depends on. An empty array is a valid, explicit declaration of no dependencies.

assumptions.description: Free-text epistemic assumptions this branch starts from (domain 2.4's 'dependencies and assumptions', the assumptions half).

methods.description: The methods this branch proposes to use to test the hypothesis (domain 2.4 'methods').

required_capabilities.description: MRR-FR-012's 'required capabilities': plain capability names this branch needs a node to publish (mrr.contracts.node_manifest.CapabilityDefinition.name), not full {name, version} references — domain 2.4 gives no further structure for this field, flagged as an open specification question in this task's PR body, mirroring schemas/evidence-anchor.schema.json's own 'recomputation_status: not a specification-given vocabulary' precedent.

stop_conditions.description: MRR-FR-012's 'stop conditions': explicit conditions under which this branch's execution must halt.

priority_rationale.description: MRR-FR-013's 'reasons for deferral' shape, generalized to every branch (not just deferred ones): why this branch was proposed at the priority/role it was. Never empty.

status.description: A small lifecycle enum with NO 'verified'/'result' value anywhere (MRR-FR-014; a Hypothesis is never a claim of result). The planner (task-packets/E4-T03.yaml) emits only 'proposed'; 'selected'/'deferred'/'rejected' are written by a later prioritization step, out of this task's scope.
